reviews.review_description: Beware of companies that go out of business. No after sales service when faults occur.
Diego, has gone missing. Not AvailableI guess he has faded into the back ground, no back up service etcA lady has his phone number now nothing to do with him.

I have emailed the contractor Re an issue with the Solar Relay, he has yet to contact me about fixing it. I'm not sure how often he checks emails.I will ring & see if the response is better. After sales/fitting is a big part of keeping the system working at a premium.I need DPR to urgently fix the problem.

We have had the system for 2 years now and no problems.  I am concerned about the warranty on our product as someone else on this site "Mary" said they had gone out of business and the owner had returned to Argentina.

My system has been in for a year and has failed due to poor workmanship. The installation was not done correctly and it has caused my inverter to fault which is not covered by warranty. DPR Network gave a lifetime warranty on workmanship, unfortunately its useless as it seems the company doesn\'t exist anymore. All phone numbers just ring out. I notice a recent video posted to You-tube though by Diego Rondinone the director of DPR is him flying his new plane!!!

I believe this company is no longer trading!! We had a solar system installed in December 2012. When I tried to contact them in February/March/April, their free number goes to a generic message bank and the landline number from their website is disconnected! I'm very conderned about the warrenty of the solar system as the comany no longer exists. I did get a hold of the sales man, David, and he was very rude and noted he is only a contractor and works for many solar companies! Very disappointing as DRP Network sitll has their website up and running. David noted the owner has gone back to Argentina!

DPR net work gives me a decent quote, not the cheapest but not the most expensive. They were able to install the panels within 2 weeks, and carried out the work efficiently and so far everything is working perfectly. I can recommend them.

No, nonsense get on the the job people, yet still friendly.Answered any question I asked.Work was performed to a high standard and was even asked to inspect their job.Recommend them highly!(being a Tradie, myself I don't tolerate crap workmanship)

Their efficiency in timely installing.attention to finalization of the requirments of the connecting supplyer's.The quotes you suggested were quite reasonable an gave me a average market price,after dealing with some very dear quotes. One is very mindfull with big deposites ,how financially sound companies may be,before comitting to the contract.

I signed up about 5-weeks ago and having the system installed this week. The sales person is very knowledgable and didn't try to sell me more than what I needed. The price was very reasonable compared with other suppliers. After the sales person left my home I got on line to check on the system specs and they matched what he told me, in fact, the system they are going to install is rated on line very highly as best for value.  Over the course of a year or so, I have had about 8-companies come to my home to quote a system for me, and DPR Network, was by far the friendliest, most informative, and straight forward without a bunch of hype, and presented a system that is good value. I'm very pleased.
All that was promised was delivered. Very professional installation. All the people we dealt with were very professional and very nice. All in all, a pleasure to deal with.

As well as giving by far the best price, DPR gave me lots of unsolicited information, almost all of it hitherto unknown and very useful.  They also installed the system 5 weeks after the quote while the best that Goodhew could offer was a delay of 6 months.  I have had the system for only one week so it is early days to comment on service etc. but so far, pending the installation of new meters by Energex, the output is exceeding my expectations.

We found the installelrs very polite, and diego was willing to explain things to us that we didn't understand.His after sale service is excellent,  called and made sure that we were happy with his installers and work that was done.

The salesman David was early and was very knowledgeable about the product and service he was selling.  He answered our questions happily and was not pushy. They took exactly 3 weeks to install our system which is what they anticipated.  The installer, a man named Diego and another gentlemen were very polite and explained what they would be doing. Before they left, he explained to me basically how the inverter operated and answered any questions that I had.  On a few occasions I telephoned the company and they answered my queries politely and satisfactorily.  Energex just connected our system this morning, about 3 1/2 weeks after the panel installation.  We recommended the DPR NETWORK to our parents and they signed up with them a few weeks ago. Can not fault the experience.
Explained everything in a very easy to understand way. Was very impressed with the service.
The money spent will recover a better return than if we left it in the bank.

The guys came at 8 a.m. and worked 'til dark! to get it fitted.We have made about 6 kw a day on a good day which doesn't seem much.We have now been attached to the grid now a couple of days. Just waiting to get some trees out of the way and some really good sunny days. Too early to tell if this was a good investment or a great investment. Considering the way electricity bills are rising I'm glad I did something now rather than later!
The installer got up on the roof and had a good look around (unlike others who came to quote for the job) and he was very prompt.
They used a contract electrician who had no confidence regarding solar.Three days later the owner came to finish the installation.
Have only just had the system installed so can't comment yet on quality or performance.

DPR Network was the 4th company to give me a quote. My first quote was online, followed up by multiple emails. In researching I found the whole industry to be so confusing with a multitude of different products, brands and features which I didn't know if I needed or not. The next 3 quotes were from my Solar Quotes application and all 3 were quite similar and enabled me to compare apples with apples, finally.These are the things that made DPR stand out from the other 3 companies:Installation time - From time of accepting quote to on my roof, winding my meter backward, 2 weeks and four days! (one quote said 6 weeks wait, more if it rained. Application to Energex was in my mailbox 8 days after I accepted the quote courtesy DPR's efficient lodging of the application, waiting now for Energex to connect to grid.Cheapest price - Not by much but every dollar counts! No extra charge bull**** for 2 storey house. No salesman bull**** just straight talking, from Diego, the electrician who knows his stuff.Ease of payment - Direct debitProduct knowledge - This company use products that they recommend from experience however are more than happy to supply any brand or model you specify. I asked about the rubber spacers, how long would they last and what were they made of? Diego did some research and supplied the information I required but then went one step further and found a superior product which I opted for. Even with the extra charge for the spacers the quote was still the cheapest for comparable product.Communication and customer service - Excellent!Post Installation - no mess whatsoever!I am one very pleased customer and wouldn't hesitate to recommend DPR Network, already have in fact!
I needed a lot of explaining and still do to check how things are working.  I would appreciate follow up for companies.
Finn,Using your services and knowledge made solar power installation simple.Thank you

I knew nothing about solar power but the salesman from DPR Network explained everything clearly in language I could understand.  I asked him every question on your checklist and he not only answered them but wrote the answers on the list for my future reference.The owner of the business installed the panels.  He arrived on time and seemed to do the work in a business like manner and left the site neat and tidy.I can't wait for my next electricity bill to see how much I have saved.

The first team of installers who came out decided that our roof was too high for them to install safely and so regretfully told us it wasn't possible. Subsequently, the company owner came to inspect the site, decided that it could be done after all and oversaw the installation himself just a couple of days later.All went well and the system works fine.......... although we're still waiting for Energex to connect us to the grid (6 weeks now and counting).
Very prompt service. Experienced installers. No hassles.
The most honest solar sales company i received a quote from. regards John.
They kept me informed at all stages.Professional approach in install and clean up.

The system was installed three days ago so is not yet operating so I am unable to comment on the quality of the system. I am very pleased with the service I received. The salesman was knowledgeable and not at all pushy.Installation team were polite and efficient.I would recommend this company.

Unfortunately on the day of the installation, the installers discovered that the pitch of the roof was too great, and as we have a decromastic roof, they could not use safety gear, and in case they lost their footing, they could damage the roof materials. Upon further investigation of possibly hiring scaffolding to install the solar panels, we decided that the installation cost was too high and that we would have to miss out on solar panels. This was a great disappointment. So when requesting quotes for solar installation, have them look at the pitch of your roof before going ahead with the quote.
Our system is now up and running, and already generating more power than we use. The installation process went without a hitch. Very happy!
DPR network offered great service, installation was on time and everthing went according to plan. The sales and installation team where fantastic.
DPR is having difficulty with an "Inverter"The electrician could not connect the AC.I am still waiting for a replacement inverter.
I really can't tell whether the quality is good or whether it's value for money yet, as it needs test of time, But I am happy with the staff of DPR and I have introduced several friends to them.
The Salesman gave me lots of helpful information without the hard sell or the B.S. that most of the others did. He was very pleasant and has helped with the process after. We decided to go with DPR.
Very poor service in getting it grid connected, although may not be DPR, but very cumbersome and slow process.
Not a pushy sales person, and answered all of our questions without the usual bulls**t and spoke to me and my wife politely. What more could you ask for?  A real nice person.
Salesman was knowledgeable, explained everything, the installation took place within the time-scales promised and the installs team were very polite and professional. Very satisfied

The installation went perfectly, I did have to call a few times to ensure my booking was correct, the date moved once but I think there was some confusion in the office as to my booking and my surname.
I found they where very easy to talk to answered all my questions, and were very good at their job. We had our panels installed within 2 weeks.

DPR did not try and oversell, answered all my questions, gave me good piece of mind, price was better than everyone else, and its a local company, so I can deal with them directly if I have any problems.

Was only contacted by 2 installers rather than three but have been happy with the service provided so far. Panels won't be installed until end of January but DPR Network have kept me fully informed of progress

Just thanks for the swervice if it wasnt for your inital feedback I probably wouoldnt have gone ahead with solar power installation because of all the reteric and cdifferent claims different broiuchers and companies are advertising on the net and though letterbox drops
